description: Land Acquisition - Payagala, Beruwala D/S Division, Kalutara District - Thalalla, Devinuwara D/S Division, Matara District and the Amendment  of Gaz.Ex.ord. No. 1823/14 of 13.08.2013 D/S Division, Athuraliya
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed declarations for acquiring specific land parcels for public purposes, including descriptions of multiple land lots with their boundaries, extents, and locations. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative procedures without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
